stock.description: Mansion International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily focused on the manufacture and sale of apparel and related accessories for infants and toddlers. Its diverse product portfolio includes essential babywear like underwear, a variety of basic garments such as rompers, robes, coats, pyjamas, windbreakers, vests, reversible jackets, pants, and leggings, as well as outdoor clothing. Additionally, the company provides a range of sleeping accessories, including baby urine pads, blankets, receiving blankets, sleeping bags, and swaddles. Fabric-based accessories like bibs, hats, mittens, booties, and towels are also part of its offerings. The company operates through two main channels: an Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business, which directly supplies products to brand companies or designated sourcing agencies predominantly in Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, and the United States; and an Original Brand Manufacturing (OBM) business. Under its proprietary "mides" brand name, the OBM segment sells its own products, alongside complementary items from third-party brands, through 12 self-operated retail stores and 11 department store counters across Hong Kong. It also conducts wholesale activities in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and Macau. Mansion International Holdings Limited, founded in 1993, is based in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
